# C++ exact-target snapshot (issue #754).
# Each source resolves to its exact owner; package-wide widening is rejected.
# Action commands come from `bazel aquery` CppCompile, never CcInfo inference.

cc/tests/fixtures/hello/main.cc -> //cc/tests/fixtures/hello:hello
cc/tests/fixtures/hello/hello.h -> //cc/tests/fixtures/hello:hello_lib
cc/tests/fixtures/hello/hello_test.cc -> //cc/tests/fixtures/hello:hello_test
resolver: kind('rule', rdeps(//..., set(<file-labels>), 1))
snapshot: action-derived CppCompile commands via aquery
generated: generated-output materialization through exact mappings
headers: multiple header contexts kept apart per target
tools: managed host-native clangd from the qualified toolchain
bazel: Bazel-9 compatibility on Bazel 9.2.0 plus rules_cc 0.2.22
